rho, prho = stats.spearmanr(k_all, d_all)
print(f"Spearman all: rho={rho:.4f}, p={prho:.4f}")

rho2, prho2 = stats.spearmanr(k, d)
print(f"Spearman n>=20: rho={rho2:.4f}, p={prho2:.4f}")

# Weighted
w = np.sqrt(np.array([r['n'] for r in allr]))
X = np.column_stack([np.ones_like(k_all), k_all])
W = np.diag(w)
beta = np.linalg.lstsq(W @ X, W @ d_all, rcond=None)[0]
y_pred = X @ beta
ss_res = np.sum(w * (d_all - y_pred)**2)
ss_tot = np.sum(w * (d_all - np.average(d_all, weights=w))**2)
r2_wls = 1 - ss_res / ss_tot
print(f"WLS sqrt(n) all: R²={r2_wls:.4f}, slope={beta[1]:.1f}")
